description: The nearest live public sensors to a point, one per layer asked for (e.g. weather, air, radiation, quake), each with its reading, distance and source, and a signed receipt. Costs $0.03 per call. The first 5 priced calls per caller are free.

layers.description: Sensor layers to search, e.g. ["weather", "air"]; default weather.

name: nearby_sensors
